purpose: Seed registry for the labeled corpus (BS-I2). Starting point for dataset candidates - none of these are downloaded or shipped; each entry documents source, license, label mapping, provenance risk and dedupe strategy so a corpus builder can make informed choices. Genre hard-negatives (GitHub/academic) remain an explicit gap (see docs/loop-guards/124-corpus-seeds.md).
selection_rules: AI-label requires model provenance (which model, prompt context) or verifiable AI-generation pipeline
Human-label requires pre-LLM date cutoff (pre-2022-11) or verified human provenance
No dataset without an identifiable license enters the corpus
Per-source mixing cap: max 25% of final corpus from any single dataset (prevents single-source style bias)
Dedup: sha1(normalized text) before split; cross-dataset dedup mandatory (Reddit/Twitter text is widely mirrored)
